title: tasks-ledger run ledger
description: One run of the tasks workflow: the shared settings of the run and the tasks it delegates. Written by tasks-plan, updated during a run only by scripts/tasks-git.js.

agents.description: Run-level agent overrides; written by the tasks skill, read by the engine, kept unchanged by the helper.

baseBranch.description: Branch that tasks without prerequisites start from.

checkTimeoutMin.description: Time limit in minutes for each shell check (setup, suite, verify.cmd).

goal.description: What the run as a whole is meant to achieve.

integrationBranch.description: Local branch that collects every merged task; set by the helper.

setup.description: Command that installs dependencies in a fresh worktree and changes no tracked file.

suite.description: Command run on the integration branch; only one that is safe to run locally.

acceptance.description: Observable end state that the reviewer checks.

files.description: Globs of the files this task owns.

needsAcceptance.description: Set on an inbox task that came without an acceptance; the engine does not start it.

proof.description: Command whose output shows the acceptance is met.
